NONE: › showing a willingness to take risks or offend people
大膽的；敢於冒險的；魯莽的；放肆的

example: He described the plan as ambitious and audacious.
他認為這是一項偉大而大膽的計劃。
an audacious remark/suggestion
大膽的評論／建議

NONE: › courage or confidence of a kind that other people find shocking or rude
大膽；勇氣

example: [ + to infinitive ] It took a lot of audacity to stand up and criticize the chairman.
站出來批評董事長需要很大的勇氣。
disapproving He had the audacity to blame me for his mistake!
他竟然把他自己的錯誤怪到我頭上，真是厚顏無恥！

NONE: › able to be heard
可以聽到的，聽得見的

example: The lecturer spoke so quietly that he was scarcely audible at the back of the hall.
這位講師的聲音太小，坐在禮堂後面的人幾乎聽不見。
She gave an audible sigh of relief.
大家聽到她如釋重負地舒了一口氣。

+ sing/pl verb: B1 [ + sing/pl verb ] the group of people together in one place to watch or listen to a play, film, someone speaking, etc.
B2 [ + sing/pl verb ] the (number of) people watching or listening to a particular television or radio programme, reading a particular book, or visiting a particular website
觀眾人數；聽眾人數；讀者人數

C: › a formal meeting that you have with an important person

example: She lectures to audiences all over the world.
她向世界各地的聽眾發表演講。
The secret to public speaking is to get the audience on your side.
當眾演講的秘訣是，一定要讓聽眾支持你的觀點。
The audience was/were clearly delighted with the performance.
無疑，觀眾非常喜歡這場演出。
The magic show had a lot of audience participation, with people shouting things to the performers and going up on stage.
這場魔術表演有很多觀眾參與的內容，有的觀眾在臺下大聲應答表演者，有的則上臺助陣。
The television company has lost a large part of its audience since it changed its programming.
該電視臺調整節目後失去了大批觀眾。
Her latest book should appeal to a large audience (= many people will want to read it).
她的新書應會吸引大批的讀者。
She had a private audience with the king.
她受到國王私下召見。

NONE: › connected with sound and the recording and broadcasting of sound
聲音的；錄音的；播音的；音頻的
› relating to hearing or sound
聽力的，聽覺的，聲音的

example: an audiocassette
卡式錄音帶
audiotape
錄音帶
an audio signal
聲頻訊號
audiotape
錄音磁帶

NONE: › a recording, on a CD or made available on the internet, of a book being read aloud
（配有光碟或線上錄音資料的）有聲讀物

example: We have a wide range of audiobooks for you to download to your smartphone or other listening device.
我們有一系列有聲讀物供你下載到智慧型手機或其他設備上收聽。

NONE: › a cassette on which sound is recorded
卡式錄音帶
› the area of science and medicine that is concerned with hearing and balance
聽力學
› a thin magnetic strip, usually made of plastic, on which sound is recorded
錄音磁帶
› used to refer to something that involves seeing and hearing
視聽的

T: › to make an official examination of the accounts of a business and produce a report
› US to go to a class or educational course for pleasure or interest, without being tested or receiving a grade at the end

NONE: › an official examination of the accounts of a business
查…的賬目；審計

example: As a senior citizen, he is allowed to audit university classes.
作為一個老年人，他得到准許可以旁聽大學的課程。
The company has an audit at the end of each financial year.
這間公司在每個財政年度的年末都要進行一次審計。

NONE: C1 a short performance that an actor, musician, dancer, etc. gives in order to show they are suitable for a particular play, film, show, etc.
（演員、樂手、舞蹈演員等的）試鏡；試奏；試唱；試演
› to give a short performance in order to show that you are suitable for a part in a film, play, show, etc., or to make someone do this
（使）試鏡；（使）試奏；（使）試唱；（使）試演

example: His audition went well and he's fairly hopeful about getting the part.
他試鏡時表現出色，很有希望能獲得這個角色。
The director is holding auditions next week for the major parts.
導演將在下週舉行試演，以確定主要角色的人選。
I'm auditioning for the part of Lady Macbeth.
我將參加試演，看能否出演麥克白夫人這個角色。
We're auditioning local rock bands for the music festival.
我們正在聽當地的搖滾樂隊試唱，以遴選出最好的一隊參加音樂節。

NONE: › someone whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report
審計員，查帳員

example: The external auditors (= from outside the company) come in once a year.
外聘審計員每年來進行一次審計。

NONE: › the part of a theatre, or similar building, where the people who are watching and listening sit
（劇院等的）聽眾席，觀眾席
› mainly US a large public building where meetings, concerts, etc. are held
劇院；禮堂；音樂廳

example: No smoking in the auditorium.
觀眾席中禁止吸煙。

NONE: › of or about hearing
聽的；聽覺的

example: It's an artificial device that stimulates the auditory areas of the brain.
這個人工裝置是用來刺激大腦聽覺區域的。

NONE: › an electronic device that is put into the brain of a deaf person during an operation so they can hear some sounds
聽覺腦幹植入體
› a nerve in the ear that carries electrical signals from the inner ear to the brain
聽覺神經（將內耳中的電訊號傳遞到大腦的神經）
